package.name: rammp_ui_bridge
package.description: Bridges an Unreal Engine touchscreen UI to the RAMMP Orchestrator's public ROS2 interface (rammp_orchestrator_interfaces). Translates UE user-input events into Orchestrator service/action calls (select_object, deselect, control, execute_action) and pushes world-state/detected-object/ InteractionPanel updates back to UE over its Remote Control WebSocket API. Also serves rammp_ui_bridge_interfaces/RequestUserInput, letting an active engine ask the user for input directly, bypassing the Orchestrator.
